sources.name: U.S. Religion Census 2020 - County Summary (usreligioncensus.org, official publisher)
sources.note: Direct .xlsx download from usreligioncensus.org (the U.S. Religion Census's own site, published by the Association of Statisticians of American Religious Bodies, ASARB), fetched with no login/registration wall. sources.name: thearda.com data-archive entry for the same study (checked per task order, cross-verified, not used as primary)
sources.note: Checked first, per task instructions. ARDA's "Downloads" tab presents a click-through data-use agreement (attribution requirement + no-warranty/liability terms, Indiana-jurisdiction clause) with an "I Agree" button -- NOT an account or free-registration wall; no email, login, or sign-up was ever requested. Once past that agreement screen, the page reveals direct download links (already present in the page's raw HTML, merely hidden via CSS until "I Agree" is clicked) pointing to osf.io/download/... files with no additional auth. One of these (the full county-level Excel data file) was fetched directly with curl with zero credentials and matches usreligioncensus.org's own file exactly (cross-checked on Loving County, TX, FIPS 48301: both report population 64, 0 congregations, 0 adherents for 2020). Not used as the primary source only because usreligioncensus.org's own site (source order option (c): an officially-published copy from the data's own publisher/ASARB) offers the same figures as a single clean summary workbook with no click-through step at all, which was simpler to automate.
